notes: Term-scoped API individual; IRI = party.uri directly. Every record is a ParliamentaryMemberCollection; records with partyCode='Independent' are IndependentMemberCollection, all other records are ParliamentaryParty. No enduring political-party identity is implied.
Used directly as the IRI of the term-scoped ParliamentaryMemberCollection individual; no separate property needed

Conditional class typing: partyCode='Independent' → IndependentMemberCollection; every other API partyCode → ParliamentaryParty. Both are subclasses of ParliamentaryMemberCollection; do not type or link the Independent collection to a term-independent individual.
xsd:string; short code identifying the collection (e.g. 'Fianna_Fáil' or 'Independent'); domain members:ParliamentaryMemberCollection. Retain the source term-scoped party.uri as the subject.
Display name of the collection (e.g. 'Fine Gael' or 'Independent'); mapped to skos:prefLabel on the ParliamentaryMemberCollection individual.

Links the ParliamentaryMemberCollection individual (party.uri as subject) to the agents:HouseTerm individual (house.uri as object); range agents:HouseTerm. HouseTerm descriptive triples remain Houses-owned.
Reference-only HouseTerm IRI = house.uri for Phase 2 linking; do not emit HouseTerm class or descriptive triples because they remain Houses-owned.
Reference-only HouseTerm IRI used as an object link; HouseTerm descriptions remain Houses-owned.
xsd:integer; ordinal term number used to validate the reference HouseTerm IRI. Phase 2 does not emit it; HouseTerm descriptions remain Houses-owned.
xsd:string; house slug used to validate the reference HouseTerm IRI. Phase 2 does not emit it; HouseTerm descriptions remain Houses-owned.
Display name of the reference HouseTerm. Phase 2 does not emit it; HouseTerm descriptions remain Houses-owned.
